method: PACER-FKG R2/R3 frozen batch audit v01
gate_interpretation: The existing gate compares non-diffused region kernel squared estimates against stable core and matched-window scalar Spearman, not RKHS directional agreement and not graph-specific improvement. Independent prior registration of the exact numerical thresholds has not been verified.
claim_boundary: Two replicas and contiguous windows qualify an estimator only. They do not establish PAM efficacy, potency, convergence or generalization.
